//library_paths: Resolved from the controller's CWD (repo_root/controller). '../' = the fork root, which holds the self-contained instrument_libs/ (TEMPLATE.md §1.2 — never the central library).
//step_type_paths: '../app/okaya_hvt' = this app payload dir, so the okaya_hvt_steps package imports and its @register_step_type decorators fire.
//stations: variable_map is resolved by the backend against THIS file's directory (app/okaya_hvt).
//instruments: No `instruments` list and no global `simulation` here (v1.5.0+/v1.5.1+): instrument instances are configured on Config -> Instruments (ids must match the variable map's `instance` names: relay1, relay2, meco, hipot — two physically separate 8ch relay cards as of 2026-09, confirmed (relay1 = muxing/IO/hipot-routes card, relay2 = tower-light module, no Yellow lamp on this bench), the NI instrument is excluded on this bench, and the old `mfm` AC meter was removed 2026-09), each with its own Simulated toggle. See docs/INSTRUMENT_DRIVERS.md.
//instrument_call_timeout_s: ctx.invoke() timeout for non-scalar actions (hipot_acw's measure_acw). Must exceed the longest real test_time this bench runs, with margin for a cold controller start's first VISA round-trip (confirmed live 2026-09: the framework's old 10.0s default raced a 10s hipot dwell and lost on cold start). Bump this if a recipe ever needs a longer withstand dwell.
